ecosystem.notes: Alphabet reports no gross flow volume for its platforms, so measure is null. payouts is TAC: FY2025 TAC was $59.926B. The 10-K defines it as amounts paid to distribution partners (browser providers, mobile carriers, OEMs, software developers) and to Google Network partners. The 10-K says the TAC rate (TAC as a percentage of advertising revenues) decreased from 20.7% to 20.3% from 2024 to 2025. platformRevenue is Google advertising revenues ($294.69B) because TAC is measured against advertising. Total Alphabet revenues were $402.836B. YouTube creator payments are not in TAC. The 10-K puts them inside 'content acquisition costs' in other cost of revenues and gives no separate amount. The YouTube $100B study figure is company-reported, covers four years in total (Jan 2021–Dec 2024) and is not an FY2025 flow; it is kept because no newer edition was looked up in this refresh. Its source URL is on services.google.com, Google's own file host; the records validator's search-page check (/google\./) would wrongly flag it.
